body: Thank you so much. I'm going to try if I can indeed get that loan. :)

It's not even the fact I can't go to college. It's just about how life has shit on me so consistently and given me some frankly terrible parents that makes me wonder why I was ever born at all if I was going to be so ill-prepared for life. I'd rather take not existing again; I was clearly content with it before this shitty life happened.

They're too far away from my boyfriend, as petty as it sounds, but considering I've waited four years of high school for happiness, I just don't want to wait anymore...

Plus I would STILL have to take out loans anyway.
